docs.title: About me
docs.text: Welcome to my coding portfolio, here you'll get to know more about me, my experience with various coding languages and software, in addition to my career aspirations.

docs.title: Education
docs.text: I studied my undergraduate degree at the University of Leicester in Biological Sciences (Genetics), I graduated in 2024 with an Upper Second Class with Honours. In September 2026 I started my postgraduate degree at Queen Mary University of London studying Artifical Intelligence in the Biosciences.

docs.title: Assembling and analysising five genomes from five clinical samples
docs.text: This project was my first assessment in my postgraduate course. We were provided with unique next-generation sequencing datasets corresponding to five clinical samples. These samples were collected from human patients who were diagnosed with suspected bacterial infections. We used the Apocrita cluster which is a heterogeneous High-Performance Computing (HPC) supercomputer cluster owned and operated by Queen Mary University of London, to generate Illumina assemblies and hybrid assemblies using Illumina and Oxford Nanopore datasets. To assemble and analyse my assemblies, various bioinformatics command-line tools were used such as SPAdes, BCFtools, FastQC, QUAST, Trimmomatic, Prokka, Bowtie2, NanoPlot and Chopper.
